title: Itezuru
titleNative: 凍鶴
synopsis: O-Tsuru (the crane), named because she used to stand on one foot to warm the other, was sold by her parents to become a geisha. She will begin as a shikomikka (apprentice) in an okiya: the house where the geisha live. By doing the commissions of his elders, Tsuru will discover the life of these women. Finally, one day, her turn arrives. She goes to her benefactor's room. Who, by paying the ceremony fees, will bring it into the world of geisha. Tsuru will then take the name of Tsurugiku and become a famous geisha in the world of pleasures. Note: It was first collected in a volume in 1992.

title: Oosaki-san to Komori-san
titleNative: 大崎さんと小森さん
synopsis: A pure love story between two people with a 50cm height difference and mismatched appearances and personalities. The new part-timer is... a child!?!? Osaki-san is tall and has a poker face, making her seem intimidating at first glance, but she's actually shy and kind. The new employee who comes to Osaki-san's workplace is Komori-san, who is only 147cm tall and very friendly. These two, who are complete opposites in appearance and personality, find themselves drawn to each other...!? Osaki-san is clumsy and a crybaby, yet a go-getter, and Komori-san is oblivious, laid-back, and a gentle, introverted type. What will become of the love between these two, who are complete opposites and have a 50cm height difference...? This is the first installment of a hilarious and heartwarming survival-of-the-fittest (?) romantic comedy about these two quirky girls. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Originally self-published on the author's Twitter, it was later acquired by Kadokawa who released the first volume on May 11, 2026.

title: Boukansha no Koi
titleNative: 傍観者の恋
synopsis: "I want to be by her side until the very last moment..." In the autumn of her twentieth year, Rachel marries her childhood friend Noah, her long-time crush. Even though she knows that the person Noah truly loved is his sister and Rachel's best friend, Alicia... Bright and beautiful Alicia was born with a heart condition, and her remaining time is limited. Rachel's marriage with Noah is built on on a lie, just to allow them to stay close to Alicia in what little time she had left. Rachel has moments of incredible happiness, but also feels guilt and heartache at the same time. However, before she knew it, she begins to notice Noah's passionate gaze looking her way… Who is the real "bystander" in this love triangle? The long-awaited manga adaptation of a heart-wrenching story of unrequited love, irreplaceable friendship, and mutual misunderstandings! (Source: J-Publishing, translated) Note: Includes three extra chapters.
